text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hear ye, hear ye, my name is No Reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The world of Umamusume is currently in a 
Warring States era—a crowd of formidable 
contenders all vying to claim the realm!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the one who shall rule all under 
heaven is me! Come, my strategist, to 
battle we ride~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
